Your Claude clock starts on your first message. So start it before you wake up: 1. Go to claude.ai and click Scheduled 2. Make a new task and type "hi" 3. Pick Haiku, the smallest model 4. Set it to daily at 6am and hit Create Start work at 9 and it resets at 11, then at 4. That's three fresh limits instead of two. It runs in the cloud, so your laptop can stay shut. But don't make it a local task in the desktop app. That one only runs while your computer is on. It works on any paid Claude plan. Your weekly limit still applies. This just moves your resets to your work hours.
